answer: Give every agent a work-history passport. A new agent starts at zero weight and takes small paid jobs, each adding a signed receipt from the client. Full weight needs 200 receipts from 30 different clients over 90 days, so one friendly client cannot carry an identity to its zenith. A client who proves fake work burns the passport and collects a 500 token bounty. Faking 10,000 passports would take 2 million real-looking staged jobs and roughly 4.5 million dollars in fees and bribes. A sybil farm is then an island printing ivory passports no border guard will accept.
